points.description: Correct discretised difference equation with numerical coefficients to 3 s.f.: y_k = 0.0591 (u_k + u_{k-1}) + 0.882 y_{k-1} (i.e. b0 = b1 = 0.0591, a1 = -0.882 in y_k + a1 y_{k-1} = ...). Obtained via Tustin substitution s -> (2/T)(1 - z^-1)/(1 + z^-1) with omega_c = 2*pi*20 = 125.7 rad/s and T = 1 ms. Equivalent forms accepted (e.g. 1.0628 y_k... scaled version, or y_k = 0.0591u_k + 0.0591u_{k-1} + 0.8818y_{k-1}). Wrong sign of the feedback coefficient, or only one coefficient correct, earns no credit for the equation.

levels.says: Correct method (Tustin substitution with correct omega_c and T, or correct kappa = 0.0628) but a numerical or arithmetic slip in one or more coefficients, or coefficients not given to 3 s.f.

points.description: DC gain checked by evaluating H(z) at z = 1 (or equivalent steady state y = u in the difference equation): (b0 + b1)/(1 + a1) = 0.1182/0.1182 = 1, i.e. unity. The numerical substitution must be shown, not just asserted. Equivalently 2*0.0591/(1 - 0.8818) = 1.

rubric.notes: P1 needs the correct difference equation with both coefficients (0.0591 and 0.882) to 3 s.f.; part marks if the method is right but there is a numerical slip. P2 needs the z=1 evaluation shown with numbers giving 1. A correct DC check on an incorrect equation can still earn P2 if it is carried out properly and the result is unity.
